description: "Reglas para documentación técnica."
---

# Documentation rules

- Write for a technical reader who must execute the procedure.
- Use exact paths, commands, prerequisites and expected results.
- Distinguish verified facts from assumptions or examples.
- Use relative links for repository files.
- Do not publish secrets, internal hostnames or real customer data.
- Keep headings scannable and avoid duplicated guidance.
- Update diagrams and examples when architecture or behavior changes.
- For operational steps, include rollback and troubleshooting information.
